label.ar: About IB Mathematics SL (نظرة عامة على رياضيات البكالوريا الدولية للمستوى القياسي (IB SL))

body.en: The IB offers two SL mathematics courses: Analysis and Approaches (AA SL) emphasises mathematical rigour, proof, and algebraic/calculus thinking. Applications and Interpretation (AI SL) emphasises modelling, technology (GDC required), statistics, and real-world problem-solving.
body.ar: The IB offers two SL mathematics courses: Analysis and Approaches (AA SL) emphasises mathematical rigour, proof, and algebraic/التفاضل والتكامل thinking. Applications and Interpretation (AI SL) emphasises modelling, technology (GDC required), الإحصاء, and real-world problem-solving.

label.en: ⚠ IB Mathematics SL Exam Traps & Command Terms
label.ar: ⚠ IB Mathematics SL Exam Traps & Command Terms (نظرة عامة على رياضيات البكالوريا الدولية للمستوى القياسي (IB SL))

body.en:
3 Significant Figures Rule: All non-exact numerical values must be written to exactly 3 significant figures unless explicitly stated otherwise. Premature rounding during intermediate steps forfeits the final accuracy mark (A1).

Command Terms: 'Show that' means the answer is already given on the question paper; you must present fully justified algebraic working with no skipped steps. 'Hence' means you must use the result of the preceding part; failing to do so earns zero method marks.

Paper 1 vs Paper 2: Paper 1 prohibits any calculator; leave answers as simplified fractions, surds, \(e\), and \(\pi\). Paper 2 requires GDC proficiency (graphing window selection, intersection solving, \(\text{binompdf}\), and \(\text{normcdf}\)).
body.ar:

Command Terms: 'Show that' means the الإجابة is already المعطيات on the question paper; you must present fully justified algebraic working with no skipped steps. 'ومنه' means you must use the result of the preceding part; failing to do so earns zero method marks.

Paper 1 vs Paper 2: Paper 1 prohibits any calculator; leave answers as simplified fractions, surds, \(e\), and \(\pi\). Paper 2 requires GDC proficiency (graphing window selection, التقاطع solving, \(\text{binompdf}\), and \(\text{normcdf}\)).

label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — First-Principles اشتقاق (Overview)

body.en:
Why Successive Multipliers & Harmonic Average Speed Work: If a quantity \(Q_0\) undergoes a percentage change \(p\%\) followed by \(q\%\), the compound multiplier is the product of individual scale factors:

\[ Q_{\text{final}} = Q_0\left(1 + \frac{p}{100}\right)\!\left(1 + \frac{q}{100}\right) = Q_0\left(1 + \frac{p + q}{100} + \frac{pq}{10000}\right) \]

Notice the cross term \(\dfrac{pq}{10000}\): an increase of \(p\%\) followed by a decrease of \(p\%\) yields \(Q_0\bigl(1 - (p/100)^2\bigr) < Q_0\). Similarly, traveling equal distance \(d\) at speeds \(v_1\) and \(v_2\) takes total time \(T = \frac{d}{v_1} + \frac{d}{v_2}\), so average speed is the harmonic mean \(v_{\text{avg}} = \dfrac{2d}{d/v_1 + d/v_2} = \dfrac{2v_1 v_2}{v_1 + v_2}\).

label.ar: Official IB Command Terms, Markscheme Codes (M1/A1/R1/AG) & 2021–2029 Syllabus Alignment (نظرة عامة على رياضيات البكالوريا الدولية للمستوى القياسي (IB SL))

body.en:
1. Critical Calculator Distinction (AA vs AI Paper 1):

Course & PaperDuration & MarksGDC PolicyPaper Format & Structure
AA SL Paper 190 min · 80 marks (40%)NO GDC AllowedSection A: 6–7 compulsory short-response questions in answer boxes (~40m)
Section B: 3 compulsory extended-response multi-part questions (~40m)
AA SL Paper 290 min · 80 marks (40%)GDC RequiredSection A: 6–7 compulsory short-response questions (~40m)
Section B: 3 compulsory extended-response questions (~40m)
AI SL Paper 190 min · 80 marks (40%)GDC Required100% Short-Response: 11–14 compulsory short-response questions (~5–8m each) testing all 5 syllabus topics with technology
AI SL Paper 290 min · 80 marks (40%)GDC Required100% Extended-Response: 5–6 compulsory multi-part modelling & statistics questions (~13–18m each)

2. Decoding IB Command Terms & Markscheme Codes:

  • Write down (1–2 marks): Obtain the answer directly (from a graph, GDC, or inspection); little or no working is required.
  • Find / Determine / Calculate: Full algebraic or GDC method setup must be shown to earn M1 (Method) and A1 (Accuracy) marks.
  • Show that ... [AG]: The final result is Answer Given (AG) on the paper. You cannot work backwards from the given answer; every intermediate step must be explicitly written to earn the final reasoning mark R1 before stating the given result.
  • Hence / Hence or otherwise: "Hence" mandates using the preceding part's result (other methods score 0); "Hence or otherwise" strongly recommends using the preceding result.
  • Follow-Through (ft): If an arithmetic slip occurs in part (a), full M1 A1ft marks can still be earned in part (b) if your method is correctly applied to your part (a) value.

2. Decoding IB Command Terms & Markscheme Codes:

  • Write down (1–2 marks): Obtain the answer directly (from a graph, GDC, or inspection); little or no working is required.
  • Find / Determine / Calculate: Full algebraic or GDC method setup must be shown to earn M1 (Method) and A1 (Accuracy) marks.
  • Show that ... [AG]: The final result is Answer Given (AG) on the paper. You cannot work backwards from the given answer; every intermediate step must be explicitly written to earn the final reasoning mark R1 before stating the given result.
  • Hence / Hence or otherwise: "Hence" mandates using the preceding part's result (other methods score 0); "Hence or otherwise" strongly recommends using the preceding result.
  • Follow-Through (ft): If an arithmetic slip occurs in part (a), full M1 A1ft marks can still be earned in part (b) if your method is correctly applied to your part (a) value.

question.en: An IB AA SL student scores 64/80 on Paper 1 (40%), 72/80 on Paper 2 (40%), and 16/20 on the Internal Assessment (20%). Calculate the student's overall weighted percentage.
question.ar: An IB AA SL student scores 64/80 on Paper 1 (40%), 72/80 on Paper 2 (40%), and 16/20 on the Internal Assessment (20%). احسب student's overall weighted percentage.

hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(\frac{64}{80} = 80\%\) لتبسيط الخطوة.
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(\frac{72}{80} = 90\%\) ، \(\frac{16}{20} = 80\%\) لتبسيط الخطوة.
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(0.40(80) + 0.40(90) + 0.20(80) = 32 + 36 + 16\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

question.en:
[Practice 2 · Medium] Three air-quality monitoring stations are positioned at \(A(2, 2)\), \(B(8, 4)\), and \(C(4, 8)\), where coordinates are measured in kilometres.
(a) Find the coordinates of the midpoint \(M\) of segment \([AB]\) and the gradient of \([AB]\). [2]
(b) Hence find the equation of the perpendicular bisector of \([AB]\) in the form \(y = mx + c\). [3]
(c) A new school is built at \(P(4.5, 4.5)\). By calculating the distance from \(P\) to each station, determine which station's Voronoi cell contains \(P\). [2]
question.ar:
[Practice 2 · Medium] Three air-quality monitoring stations are positioned at \(A(2, 2)\), \(B(8, 4)\), and \(C(4, 8)\), حيث coordinates are measured in kilometres.
(a) أوجد إحداثيات the midpoint \(M\) of segment \([AB]\) and the gradient of \([AB]\). [2]
(b) Hence أوجد equation of the perpendicular bisector of \([AB]\) in the form \(y = mx + c\). [3]
(c) A new school is built at \(P(4.5, 4.5)\). By calculating the distance from \(P\) to each station, حدّد which station's Voronoi cell contains \(P\). [2]

hints.en: IB Markscheme (7 marks — AI SL Paper 1): (a) Midpoint \(M = \left(\frac{2+8}{2}, \frac{2+4}{2}\right) = (5, 3)\) ; \(m_{AB} = \frac{4 - 2}{8 - 2}\).
hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(M = \left(\frac{2+8}{2}, \frac{2+4}{2}\right) = (5, 3)\) ، \(m_{AB} = \frac{4 - 2}{8 - 2}\) لتبسيط الخطوة.
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(m_\perp = -\frac{1}{m_{AB}} = -3.00\) ، \(y - 3 = -3.00(x - 5) \implies y = -3.00x + 18.00\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

hints.en: (c) Distances: \(PA = 3.54\text{ km}, PB = 3.54\text{ km}, PC\) \(\implies\) closest to Station \(A\).
hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(PA = 3.54\text{ km}, PB = 3.54\text{ km}, PC\) ، \(\implies\) ، \(A\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

solution.en:
IB Markscheme (7 marks — AI SL Paper 1):
(a) Midpoint \(M = \left(\frac{2+8}{2}, \frac{2+4}{2}\right) = (5, 3)\) ; \(m_{AB} = \frac{4 - 2}{8 - 2} = 0.333\)
(b) Perpendicular gradient \(m_\perp = -\frac{1}{m_{AB}} = -3.00\)
Equation: \(y - 3 = -3.00(x - 5) \implies y = -3.00x + 18.00\)
(c) Distances: \(PA = 3.54\text{ km}, PB = 3.54\text{ km}, PC = 3.54\text{ km}\) \(\implies\) closest to Station \(A\)

question.en:
[Practice 4 · Medium] A coastguard vessel leaves Port \(A\) and travels \(11\text{ km}\) on a true bearing of \(045^\circ\) to Waypoint \(B\). It then changes course and travels \(15\text{ km}\) on a bearing of \(145^\circ\) to Rescue Point \(C\).
(a) Show that \(\angle ABC = 80^\circ\). [2]
(b) Find the direct distance \(AC\) in \(\text{km}\), giving your answer to 3 significant figures. [3]
(c) Find the area of the sea region enclosed by triangle \(ABC\). [2]
question.ar:
[Practice 4 · Medium] A coastguard vessel leaves Port \(A\) and travels \(11\text{ km}\) on a true bearing of \(045^\circ\) to Waypoint \(B\). It then changes course and travels \(15\text{ km}\) on a bearing of \(145^\circ\) to Rescue Point \(C\).
(a) Show that \(\angle ABC = 80^\circ\). [2]
(b) أوجد direct distance \(AC\) in \(\text{km}\), giving your answer to 3 signإذا كانicant figures. [3]
(c) أوجد مساحة the sea region enclosed by triangle \(ABC\). [2]

hints.en: IB Markscheme (7 marks — AA/AI SL Paper 2, Section A): (a) Using alternate/co-interior angles with the North line at \(B\): \(\angle ABC = (180^\circ - 145^\circ) + 45^\circ\) [AG]
hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(B\) ، \(\angle ABC = (180^\circ - 145^\circ) + 45^\circ\) لتبسيط الخطوة.
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(= \frac{1}{2}(11)(15)\sin(80^\circ)\) ، \(= 81.2\text{ km}^2\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

solution.en:
IB Markscheme (7 marks — AA/AI SL Paper 2, Section A):
(a) Using alternate/co-interior angles with the North line at \(B\): \(\angle ABC = (180^\circ - 145^\circ) + 45^\circ = 80^\circ\) [AG]
(b) By the Cosine Rule: \(AC^2 = 11^2 + 15^2 - 2(11)(15)\cos(80^\circ)\)
\(AC = \sqrt{288.70} = 17.0\text{ km}\) (3 s.f.)
(c) Area \(= \frac{1}{2}(11)(15)\sin(80^\circ)\) \(= 81.2\text{ km}^2\) (3 s.f.)

question.en: Consider the function \( f(x) = 2x + 5 \). What is the value of \( f(3) \)?
question.ar: Consider the function \( f(x) = 2x + 5 \). ما قيمة \( f(3) \)?

hints.en: To find \( f(3) \), substitute \( x=3 \) into the function \( f(x) = 2x + 5 \).
hints.ar: To أوجد \( f(3) \), عوّض \( x=3 \) into the function \( f(x) = 2x + 5 \).

hints.en: Set up the formula/expression: \(f(3) = 2(3) + 5\). Substitute and simplify: \(f(3) = 6 + 5\).
hints.ar: جهّز الصيغة أو العبارة الرياضية: \(f(3) = 2(3) + 5\). عوّض بالقيم وبسّط العبارة: \(f(3) = 6 + 5\).

solution.en: To find \( f(3) \), substitute \( x=3 \) into the function \( f(x) = 2x + 5 \). \( f(3) = 2(3) + 5 = 6 + 5 = 11 \). [M1] [A1]
solution.ar: To أوجد \( f(3) \), عوّض \( x=3 \) into the function \( f(x) = 2x + 5 \). \( f(3) = 2(3) + 5 = 6 + 5 = 11 \). [M1] [A1]
